sources.title: 第5次静岡市総合計画
sources.review_boundary: The official February 17, 2026 mayoral press-material route publishes the fifth comprehensive plan, and the mayoral policy statement confirms the new 2026–2035 plan period. Exact indicator pages, target definitions, denominators, and record-level evidence remain Phase 13 review work.

sources.title: 第5次静岡市総合計画実施計画の期間・評価運用に関する公式参照
sources.review_boundary: The official administrative-reform plan explicitly states that the fifth comprehensive-plan implementation plan initially covers fiscal 2026–2030 and that planned indicators are evaluated against actual results and revised. This verifies the implementation layer structurally; the canonical implementation-plan document itself remains a Phase 13 evidence-resolution task.

sources.title: 令和6年度 取組評価シート②（第4次総合計画実施計画登載取組）
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 evaluation sheet covers initiatives listed in the fourth comprehensive-plan implementation plan. It is retained as legacy evidence and must not be attributed to the fifth comprehensive plan that starts in fiscal 2026.

sources.title: 令和8年度当初予算
sources.review_boundary: The official fiscal 2026 initial-budget landing publishes the budget proposal overview, account budget books, and explanatory materials. Proposal values, enacted values, supplementary budgets, debt authorizations, execution, and project financing remain separate evidence states until record-level review.

sources.title: 決算
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 major-policy-results and settlement publication route is verified. It predates the fifth comprehensive plan; general, special, enterprise, audit-opinion, financial-health, and policy-outcome records remain separate until record-level review.

unresolved_layers.boundary: The fifth-plan implementation layer and its 2026–2030 period are explicitly verified by an official city source, but a separate canonical implementation-plan document or dedicated landing has not yet been resolved. Source-inventory coverage is complete at the current official publication depth; the canonical document remains a record-level evidence blocker and must not be replaced by inference.

The fifth comprehensive plan starts in fiscal 2026, so fiscal 2024 fourth-plan evaluation material cannot serve as a current fifth-plan annual result. Current-plan annual progress is explicitly not yet available at this stage; this absence is preserved as an availability boundary for Phase 13 rather than treated as a missing source-inventory search.

quality_boundary: Source-inventory coverage is complete at the maximum current official publication depth: the fifth comprehensive plan, official structural evidence for its 2026–2030 implementation layer, legacy fourth-plan progress, fiscal 2026 budget route, and fiscal 2024 settlement route are all identified. The unresolved canonical implementation document and not-yet-available fifth-plan annual result remain explicit Phase 13 evidence blockers. This does not silently carry the fourth plan into the current period and does not promote indicators, progress judgments, projects, budget values, settlement values, causal claims, cross-city comparability, or policy achievement to Reviewed status.
next_action: Enter Phase 13 record review using the verified fifth-plan identity and implementation structure. Resolve the canonical implementation-plan document when published or located, retain the annual-progress layer as not yet available until an official fifth-plan result exists, review fiscal 2026 budget states and values separately, and preserve fiscal 2024 settlement and fourth-plan progress strictly as pre-fifth-plan historical evidence.
